value.name: Diana stresses opening night deadline
value.description: Diana reminds the cast that opening night is only five days away, emphasizing urgency.
evidence:
DIANA
Opening night is FRIDAY. That is five days. Not six. Not seven. Five.

value.name: Diana pressures cast to deliver
value.description: Diana tells the cast they must fill four hundred seats and give paying audiences something extraordinary.
evidence:
DIANA (CONT'D)
We have four hundred seats to fill. Each of those is a person who paid for something extraordinary.

value.name: Diana questions Leon's injury
value.description: Diana singles out Leon and asks for the story behind his injured arm.

value.name: Leon explains ladder accident
value.description: Leon says he injured himself after a ladder slipped while he was fixing a light in his apartment.
evidence:
LEON
(sighing)
I was fixing a light in my apartment. The ladder slipped. I fell off the ladder. That is the whole story.

DIANA
You fell off a ladder.

LEON
I fell off a ladder.

value.name: Oscar mocks Leon's condition
value.description: Oscar dryly undercuts Leon by calling attention to the leading man's injury.

value.name: Leon insists he will recover
value.description: Leon defends himself by saying he will be fully healed by closing night.
evidence:
LEON
The leading man who will be fully healed by closing night, thank you.

value.name: Priya says she warned Leon
value.description: Priya states that she twice told Leon to call building maintenance instead of handling the repair himself.
evidence:
PRIYA
For the record, I told him twice to call building maintenance.

value.name: Leon reveals self-reliant streak
value.description: Leon says he prefers to handle things himself, revealing a stubbornly independent attitude.
evidence:
LEON
For the record, I prefer to handle things myself.

value.name: Leon says it's his first Ravenswood production
value.description: Leon notes that this is his first production at Ravenswood and that he is glad to finally work there.
evidence:
LEON (CONT'D)
First production I have done here, for the record. Good to finally work at Ravenswood.

value.name: Diana welcomes Leon and calls places
value.description: Diana affirms that Leon is welcome at Ravenswood and announces that Act Three begins in ten minutes.
evidence:
DIANA
And we are glad to have you. Now -- Act Three. Places in ten minutes.
